item.recasting.abyss_flame.desc: Pure matte black that devours surrounding light, forming a silent dark region.
item.recasting.chaos_flame.desc: Indeterminate colors, may display any color on the spectrum within the same second.
item.recasting.cradle_flame.desc: Soft goose-yellow, its light like the most peaceful candlelight, bringing tranquility to the heart.
item.recasting.craftsman_flame.desc: Steady bronze-yellow with regular flame shape, occasionally flashing with metallic luster.
item.recasting.holy_flame.desc: Pure milky white flame, surrounded by a faint golden halo at the edges.
item.recasting.ice_core_flame.desc: Outer layer is blazing bright blue, but the core is deep, absolute dark blue that seems to absorb light.
item.recasting.karma_flame.desc: Invisible transparent fire, only revealing densely interwoven silver and blood-red threads when burning the threads of fate.
item.recasting.last_words_flame.desc: Amber gold, with a fading starlight representing life's final color sealed deep in the core.
item.recasting.memory_flame.desc: Translucent glazed color, with hazy light and shadow floating in the flame.
item.recasting.mirage_flame.desc: Refracted rainbow colors with blurred edges, as if seen through a layer of mist.
item.recasting.mirror_flame.desc: Highly reflective mirror-like color like mercury, perfectly reflecting the appearance of the flame it 'imitates'.
item.recasting.obsession_flame.desc: Restless orange-red, with pale flashes at the core.
item.recasting.other_shore_flame.desc: Cold bluish-white, flickering like a candle, without warmth.
item.recasting.ouroboros_flame.desc: A self-devouring Möbius ring-shaped flame flow, cycling between silver-gray and dark blue.
item.recasting.poetry_ash_flame.desc: Hazy moon-white, with pale golden runes dancing like text at the core.
item.recasting.royal_flame.desc: Majestic dark gold and deep purple interwoven, the flame rising like an imperial crown.
item.recasting.sin_flame.desc: Foul dark red with ominous black veins, emitting a charred stench when burning.
item.recasting.tide_flame.desc: With the ebb and flow, colors shift from deep purple at new moon to silvery white like sea foam at full moon.
